sessions.text:
User: I'm setting up some Python tooling on my laptop.
Assistant: Nice. Do you have a linter you like?
User: I prefer flake8 for linting. Also, always write commit messages in the imperative mood.
Assistant: Understood. I'll default to flake8 and write imperative commit messages.
User: Cool, that's all for now.

User: Starting Project Eclipse today, a scheduling service for the ops team.
Assistant: Good luck. Any tooling constraints?
User: For Project Eclipse, use Ruff for linting because it is much faster in CI.
Assistant: Got it. For Project Eclipse I'll use Ruff.
User: Thanks. See you next time.

User: One more thing on Project Eclipse.
Assistant: Sure, what is it?
User: Actually, for Project Eclipse, switch to Pylint for linting because the team wants its deeper checks.
Assistant: Noted. Project Eclipse moves to Pylint.
User: Great. That's all.
